description: `Afg` in liberation-serif upright at 400, and again in its BoldItalic at 700. The letters are chosen because they are the ones that give an italic away: a true italic redraws `a` and `f` rather than leaning them, and `g` changes shape entirely. So a build that produced an oblique -- the upright sheared, which is what reaching for a `slnt` axis would give -- fails here even though the picture would still look slanted. It is also the only fixture where weight and slant are asked for together, so a build that read the italic table but ignored the weight draws Italic where BoldItalic belongs.
